app.description: The app the scenes run against.

url.description: Where the app runs, for example http://localhost:3000

start.description: The command that starts it when it is not up, for example npm run dev

as.description: The address films show in the window's bar, for example acme.com

brand.description: Colours and fonts of films and posts.

theme.description: A set of colours to start from; colours written here win.

fontImport.description: A stylesheet address that brings the fonts.

looks.description: Other looks, each laid over `look`. Built in: phone, tablet, dark, light, cartoon, sketch, blueprint.

sessions.description: Saved logins kept elsewhere, by name, for example a Playwright storage state file.

replace.description: Text to swap wherever the page shows it (whole words).

date.description: The date and time the app believes it is.

portal.description: The address of the platform `scenlit publish` sends videos to. SCENLIT_PORTAL or --to say it for one run.

product.description: The product these videos belong to on the platform: its page is <platform>/<product>. Else made from the brand's name.

save.description: Where every scene's results are also kept in your project. {scene} and {shape} in a path are filled in. A copy is made on every run.

film.description: The film with its player and all it needs: a folder for any web host.

video.description: The MP4 when it is exported, its captions and poster beside it; or a place for each shape: { wide, square, vertical }.

formats.description: Kinds of film, each a set of style changes (and, when it needs them, brand, look and shape). Built in: demo, tutorial, feature, trailer, canvas, launch, recording, short, keynote, loop, source.

model.description: Who works out plain-language steps the first time.

voice.description: Narration. Paid providers only run from `scenlit voice`.

provider.description: none, say, elevenlabs, openai, command, or a module of your own such as ./tools/voice.mjs

command.description: For the command provider: a program with {file}, and {text} or the line on standard input.

says.description: Pronunciations: what to say for a word, for example { "Scenlit": "Seen lit" }.

voices.description: Settings per language, over the main ones: { "de": { "voice": "Anna" } }.

viewport.description: A smaller viewport gives bigger type in the film.

hide.description: CSS selectors to hide: cookie banners, chat bubbles.

settle.description: Milliseconds to wait after each action.

filter.description: A CSS filter laid on every picture. Built in: url(#nt-sketch), url(#nt-toon), url(#nt-blueprint).

style.description: Film style changes this look brings (background, window, cursor, captions, motion).

brand.description: Colours this look brings for the words, over the brand's: text, muted, accent.

fill.description: The page is the whole frame, edge to edge (a component made to be filmed)

name.description: Words beside the cursor, as on a shared canvas

board.description: The places of the film are frames side by side on one canvas, and the camera travels between them

select.description: The colour of a selection (the select spotlight)

player.description: The player around the film (never part of an MP4).

accent.description: The colour of its controls. The brand's accent when not given.

controls.description: Which controls it has, in this order; false for none.

marks.description: The places a viewer can go to, marked on the bar: the film's chapters, or without any, each step that says something. false: none.

poster.description: What waits before the film is played: seconds into the film, or a picture in your project.

motion.description: Which piece moves what (scenlit motion list). Your own pieces go in .scenlit/motion.js.

source.description: Show the scene file down the left, the line now playing lit (wide films)
